name: Access Database Viewer — Open MDB & ACCDB Files
description: Open, search & export Microsoft Access .mdb/.accdb files 100% locally: CSV, Excel, SQLite. No upload, no network access at all.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'
